release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.22 compacts the bottom action dock by removing unused bet-sizing and 174-range rows, allowing the table felt to expand. VIP becomes a distinct Private Club table with richer gold-and-emerald trim, VIP-only header and seat badges. Every VIP opponent is PRO ONLY (five level-5 local CPUs; no weaker tier), with 256 postflop decision samples instead of 48. The fixed 174-scenario preflop chart remains unchanged. This is a stronger local policy, not solver-exact GTO.
